title: Zoolander
logline: Ben Stiller as a dim male model brainwashed into an assassination plot. Absurdist fashion parody.
overview: Clear the runway for Derek Zoolander, VH1's three-time male model of the year. His face falls when hippie-chic Hansel scooters in to steal this year's award. The evil fashion guru Mugatu seizes the opportunity to turn Derek into a killing machine. It's a well-designed conspiracy and only with the help of Hansel and a few well-chosen accessories like Matilda can Derek make the world safe for male models everywhere.

title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
logline: Will Ferrell as a vain 1970s San Diego news anchor. Absurdist ensemble comedy built on improvised non sequiturs.
overview: It's the 1970s and San Diego anchorman Ron Burgundy is the top dog in local TV, but that's all about to change when ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone arrives as a new employee at his station.
tagline: They bring you the news so you don't have to get it yourself.

title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
logline: Will Ferrell as a NASCAR driver. Absurdist improv comedy in the Anchorman mold.
overview: The fastest man on four wheels, Ricky Bobby, is one of the greatest drivers in NASCAR history. A big, hairy American winning machine, Ricky has everything a dimwitted daredevil could want, a luxurious mansion, a smokin' hot wife, and all the fast food he can eat. But Ricky's turbo-charged lifestyle hits an unexpected speed bump when he's bested by flamboyant Euro-idiot Jean Girard and reduced to a fear-ridden wreck.
tagline: The story of a man who could only count to #1.

title: Mean Girls
logline: A homeschooled teen navigates a high-school clique. Tina Fey script: dense, quotable one-liners and satire.
overview: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

title: Tropic Thunder
logline: Actors filming a war movie end up in a real one. Hollywood satire and action parody.
overview: A group of self-absorbed actors set out to make the most expensive war film ever. When budgets skyrocket and schedules fall far behind, the director tries to save the production by leading his cast into the jungles of Southeast Asia, where they inadvertently encounter real danger.

title: Step Brothers
logline: Will Ferrell and John C. Reilly as fortysomething men-children forced to share a house. Escalating improvised absurdism.
subtitle_release: Step Brothers 2008 m-720p Roboris (fixed and corrected)
overview: Brennan Huff and Dale Doback might be grown men. But that doesn't stop them from living at home and turning into jealous, competitive stepbrothers when their single parents marry. Brennan's constant competition with Dale strains his mom's marriage to Dale's dad, leaving everyone to wonder whether they'll ever see eye to eye.

title: The Hangover
logline: Three friends retrace a lost night in Las Vegas to find the groom. Situational and shock comedy.
overview: When three friends finally come to after a raucous night of bachelor-party revelry, they find a baby in the closet and a tiger in the bathroom. But they can't seem to locate their best friend, Doug – who's supposed to be tying the knot. Launching a frantic search for Doug, the trio perseveres through a nasty hangover to try to make it to the church on time.
tagline: Some guys just can't handle Vegas.

title: Superbad
logline: Two high-school seniors try to buy alcohol for a party. Raunchy, dialogue-driven teen comedy with a cop subplot.
overview: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

title: Wedding Crashers
logline: Owen Wilson and Vince Vaughn crash weddings to meet women. Fast-talking banter comedy.
overview: John and his buddy Jeremy are emotional criminals who know how to use a woman's hopes and dreams for their own carnal gain. Their modus operandi: crashing weddings. Normally, they meet guests who want to toast the romantic day with a random hook-up. But when John meets Claire, he discovers what true love – and heartache – feels like.

title: Elf
logline: Will Ferrell as a human raised by elves who goes to New York. Fish-out-of-water family comedy.
overview: When young Buddy falls into Santa's gift sack on Christmas Eve, he's transported back to the North Pole and raised as a toy-making elf by Santa's helpers. But as he grows into adulthood, he can't shake the nagging feeling that he doesn't belong. Buddy vows to visit Manhattan and find his real dad, a workaholic.
